name: Michelle M. Gloria
original_name: ミッシェル・M・グロリア
source:
Current head of Gloria household. She seems to fall for Kira from the first moment she meets him.

However, she seems to be able control her emotions so that she won't have a problem firing him if he doesn't do his job.
